outputVoltage.reference: HC-SR501 PIR motion sensor module datasheet: output high level 3.3 V, from the module's 7133 regulator

dropoutVoltage.reference: HC-SR501 PIR motion sensor module datasheet gives a 4.5 V minimum supply; the output is assumed to sag below that

quiescentCurrent.reference: HC-SR501 PIR motion sensor module datasheet: static current under 50 µA

contactResistance.reference: Output stage modelled as 1 kΩ to the 3.3 V rail when triggered; the module drives a few milliamps

closed.reference: Output: 1 while motion is detected, 0 when idle

maxVoltage.reference: HC-SR501 PIR motion sensor module datasheet: supply 4.5 V to 20 V DC

closed.reference: Output: 1 while motion is detected, 0 when idle
